title.narrative: To ensure provision of quality care and prevention services for all people in Kenya with TB, leprosy and lung diseases - Kenya (01-Jul-2024-30-Jun-2027)

description.narrative: Kenya, Tuberculosis, The National Treasury & Economic Planning of the Government of Kenya (TNT)This program has the following goals: To ensure provision of quality care and prevention services for TB,and lung diseases for all people in Kenya. The objectives of this program are: Reduce TB incidence rate by 80% by 2030 compared to 2015 baseline. Reduce TB mortality rate by 90% by 2030 compared to 2015 baseline. Zero families facing caterstrohic cost due to TB and chronic lung disease
